name: FFS_QBI_FILL_SCHEDULE_LOG
description: Stores a modification history for the corresponding parent table.

columns.name: SCHEDULE_LOG_ID
columns.description: Primary Key. Unique identifies log record of automatic populate schedule changes.

columns.name: ACTION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the action.

columns.name: ACTION_TIME
columns.description: Who Column: Time in GMT when action was performed.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: Who Column: Identifies user the operation is performed by. Zero value means internal application task. Foreign Key. Points to USER_ID in FFS_USER.

columns.name: AREA_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key. Points to AREA_ID in FFS_QBI_CAPACITY_AREA.

columns.name: CATEGORY_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key. Points to WORK_SKILL_ID in FFS_WORK_SKILL.

columns.name: FIELD_ID
columns.description: Field identifier that was updated.

columns.name: ACTION
columns.description: Action description that was performed.

columns.name: OLD_STATUS
columns.description: Old value of status of this record that controls if the corresponding action is performed automatically.

columns.name: NEW_STATUS
columns.description: New value of status of this record that controls if the corresponding action is performed automatically.

columns.name: OLD_OPERATION
columns.description: Old value of an operation that should be performed.

columns.name: NEW_OPERATION
columns.description: New value of an operation that should be performed.

columns.name: OLD_SOURCE_FIELD_ID
columns.description: Old source field that should be updated.

columns.name: NEW_SOURCE_FIELD_ID
columns.description: New source field that should be updated.

columns.name: OLD_SOURCE_OFFSET
columns.description: Old source day offset that should be updated.

columns.name: NEW_SOURCE_OFFSET
columns.description: New source day offset that should be updated.

columns.name: OLD_SOURCE_COUNT
columns.description: Old value of a number of days/weeks that should be used as a source of data.

columns.name: NEW_SOURCE_COUNT
columns.description: New value of a number of days/weeks that should be used as a source of data.

columns.name: OLD_TARGET_OFFSET
columns.description: Old source target offset that should be updated.

columns.name: NEW_TARGET_OFFSET
columns.description: New source target offset that should be updated.

columns.name: OLD_TARGET_COUNT
columns.description: Old value of a number of days/weeks that should be populated.

columns.name: NEW_TARGET_COUNT
columns.description: New value of a number of days/weeks that should be populated.

columns.name: OLD_MULTIPLY_BY
columns.description: Old value of a percent value for the percent_shift operation.

columns.name: NEW_MULTIPLY_BY
columns.description: New value of a percent value for the percent_shift operation.

columns.name: OLD_RECURRENCE
columns.description: Old value that defines when this operation should be performed automatically.

columns.name: NEW_RECURRENCE
columns.description: New value that defines when this operation should be performed automatically.

columns.name: OLD_DAY_OF_WEEK
columns.description: Old value of schedule day of week.

columns.name: NEW_DAY_OF_WEEK
columns.description: New value of schedule day of week.

columns.name: OLD_START_TIME
columns.description: Old time of day when this operation should be performed.

columns.name: NEW_START_TIME
columns.description: New time of day when this operation should be performed.

columns.name: OLD_WITHIN
columns.description: Old value in minutes when schedule should be applied after start time.

columns.name: NEW_WITHIN
columns.description: New value in minutes when schedule should be applied after start time.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
